name: Zhuhai Bojay Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhuhai Bojay Electronics Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and technical services of industrial automation, intelligent equipment, and system solutions in China and internationally. The company provides RF test, acoustic test, electrical test, optical test, and vision test solutions, as well as automation and industrial strapping Solution. Its products are used in consumer electronics, big data and AI computing power, new energy vehicles, semiconductors, passive components, and other industries. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Zhuhai, China.
